sources.title: gamblerinsight-1-qwen2.5-14b-smoke - FriendliAI
sources.snippet: Model Overview GamblerInsight Smoke (gamblerinsight-1-qwen2.5-14b-smoke) is a smoke-test checkpoint for multi-hop financial reasoning and a tool-calling agent. It is fine-tuned from Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on the DGX Spark GB10 platform to validate the end-to-end pipeline: 2-turn tool-calling trajectories, adapter merge into a standard safetensors checkpoint, and HuggingFace Hub deployment ...
